text.en: Seek emergency care for rapidly spreading, blistering or peeling rash, especially with fever or painful mouth or eyes. Call emergency services for breathing difficulty, throat tightness or trouble speaking.

text.en: Erythema multiforme, reactive infectious mucocutaneous eruption (RIME), staphylococcal scalded skin syndrome and other severe drug eruptions can resemble it; specialist examination is needed.

text.en: These mimics have different causes and treatment. Mucosal-predominant illness after infection, particularly in children with limited skin disease, needs specialist assessment for RIME rather than automatic SJS labeling.

text.zh-CN: 恢复可能持续数周至数月；保留眼科及其他专科复诊，持续视力、口腔或生殖泌尿问题需要继续处理。
text.en: Recovery may take weeks to months. Keep eye and other specialist follow-up for persistent visual, oral or genital/urinary problems.

text.zh-CN: 长期回避致病药不等于所有药都不能用；复诊时明确哪些药禁用、有哪些替代药，并让后续开药的医生看到反应记录。
text.en: Avoiding a culprit does not mean avoiding every medicine; clarify prohibited and alternative medicines at follow-up and show the reaction record to future prescribers.

text.zh-CN: 急性期可有脱水、感染、休克或器官损伤；以后可有眼部损伤、瘢痕及黏膜狭窄。发生这些问题不取决于皮疹看上去是否已消退。
text.en: Acute complications include dehydration, infection, shock and organ injury; later effects include eye damage, scarring and mucosal narrowing.

text.zh-CN: 确认致病药后长期避免该药；相关药物是否也需回避由医生明确。把药名和 SJS/TEN 反应告知所有医护，考虑携带医疗警示信息，不自行试服验证。
text.en: Avoid the confirmed culprit long term; clinicians identify related medicines to avoid. Tell all providers the drug name and SJS/TEN reaction, consider medical identification, and do not retry it yourself.
